tips.title: Ask in plain words
tips.text: You do not need special commands. Write your question the way you would say it to a friend.

tips.title: Give it a little context
tips.text: Say who the answer is for and what you want. For example: 'a short email to my landlord about a broken tap'.

tips.title: Check what matters
tips.text: AI can be wrong. For health, money or legal questions, check with a trusted source or a professional.

quote.text: You do not need to understand the engine to learn to drive. Start with one small trip.
quote.author: AIforAll (an original line)

tip.title: Say who the answer is for
tip.text: Add one line like 'Explain this to a ten-year-old' or 'Keep it short and polite'. The same question gets a very different answer.

useCase.title: Write a calm reply to a hard email
useCase.text: Paste the email you received and say what you want to answer in one sentence. Ask for a polite reply. Read it, change it, and send it yourself. Never paste private details.
